newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish police arrest militiamen for hash haul.
newsitem.headline: Turkish police arrest militiamen for hash haul.

text.p: Police have arrested two members of an anti-rebel militia in the mainly Kurdish southeast of Turkey in connection with the seizure of 120 kg (264 lb) of hashish, Anatolian news agency said on Friday.
It said the two village guards were detained with one other person in the province of Van. Part of the hashish haul was dug up from a garden.
Turkey pays and arms around 70,000 guards, mainly Kurds, to fight Kurdistan Workers Party guerrillas. Human rights groups have often accused the guards of involvement in common crime.
Interior Minister Meral Aksener told Turkish television last week that a total of 23,000 village guards had been dismissed since 1985 for suspected criminal activities.
The government has been rocked since early November by a scandal over alleged links between security officials, a village guard leader and drug smuggling.
